title: Hide Report Triage evidence badge
summary: Suppress the visible Report Triage evidence badge while keeping the panel marked as read-only evidence for existing WebView safety guards.
reason: The Reports page showed an inline evidence chip next to the Report Triage heading; the operator asked to hide that box.
behavior_before: Report Triage rendered as an evidence panel and displayed the shared inline evidence badge after its heading.
behavior_after: Report Triage remains an evidence panel, but the inline heading badge is hidden for that panel only.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_reports_view_static.py asserts the Report Triage panel remains data-panel-type="evidence" while the Report Triage evidence badge override is present.
rollback_plan: Remove the report-triage-panel CSS override and the matching Reports static assertions.
